summary: The MatRIS energy-and-force replay executor was implemented and passed its local package preflight and isolated Torch loss/checkpoint smoke test. The reviewed package now also binds seven completed frozen-held-out VASP labels, with six primary-metric structures and one diagnostic-only boundary structure. No MatRIS package or checkpoint is installed locally, so real MatRIS runtime integration remains untested and no MZ73 job or fine-tuning was submitted.

payload.objective: Obtain separate user authorization for a bounded MZ73 MatRIS runtime-integration smoke test before any full replay fine-tuning execution.
current_evidence: The execution-package preflight passes for 30 optimizer samples: 21 TS energy-force samples and 9 adsorption force-replay samples.
Four adsorption structures are validation-only; seven frozen TS structures have VASP labels and remain excluded from optimizer/replay use.
The held-out primary metric contains six structures; held_boundary_12 remains diagnostic-only.
Exact-structure and rounded translation-invariant geometry overlap between optimizer/replay and held-out structures are both zero.

The isolated Torch smoke test produced finite energy and force gradients, reduced combined loss from 0.333100 to 0.030289, computed force-tail and relative-energy metrics, and wrote a hashable toy checkpoint.
Ten related unit tests pass; Ruff and Python compilation pass for the changed executor and package builder.
The local environment lacks the MatRIS package and the real base checkpoint, so this test does not prove MatRIS graph/model/runtime compatibility.
No MZ73 submission, real checkpoint update, complete-path rerun, VASP job, Dimer, TS acceptance, or barrier action occurred.
payload.one_executable_step: Prepare and, only after separate user authorization, run one bounded MZ73 no-promotion runtime smoke using the frozen base checkpoint and a minimal reviewed subset; do not start full fine-tuning automatically.
payload.submission_boundary: The local test authorizes no remote action. MZ73 runtime smoke, full MatRIS fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, complete path rerun, AQCat25 returned-path audit, VASP micro-NEB, Dimer, TS acceptance, and barrier reporting remain unauthorized.
done_when: The MZ73 environment imports the exact MatRIS runtime and loads the frozen base checkpoint hash.
One bounded energy-plus-force backward/optimizer smoke step on a reviewed training subset completes with finite loss and gradients while held-out exclusions remain enforced.
The smoke result and any temporary checkpoint are returned for work-side review and are explicitly marked non-promoted.
The user separately authorizes or declines the full replay fine-tuning execution.
